title: fix(app-shell,i18n): word the stored_expression strip reason ahead of the spec pin (objectui#13178)
body:
Fixes #13178
Clause-②: no

## What

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24778 (draft) adds a fifth arm, `stored_expression`, to `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']`: a stored field whose declared expression the engine computes on every write keeps the computed value, not the one the caller sent (the field IS written, unlike `computed`). `STRIPPED_LINE` in `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` is keyed by that union, so the objectstack Console Pin Gate, which builds the pinned objectui against objectstack's own spec, would fail on a missing key once #24778 lands. This lands the row first, in the objectui#11206 shape.

- `STRIPPED_LINE`'s key type is a `Record` keyed by `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason'] | 'stored_expression'`. Against the published pin (which does not declare the arm) the required key set is the pin's four plus the literal; against #24778's spec it is the five it declares. No excess-key error on either side, and the next arm upstream adds is still a missing key here. The docblock records why, and the tripwire: delete the widening at the pin bump that declares the value.
- One row, `stored_expression`, through a new key `detail.writeStrippedStoredExpression` with `{{fields}}`. English: "Computed from the record, so the computed value was saved instead of the one sent: FIELDS". A real translation in all ten packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/`, never "read-only".
- Changeset `.changeset/13178-stripped-stored-expression.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Pins (`writeWarningToast.test.ts`)

- (a) New case `words reason stored_expression as a computed value saved in place of the one sent, in en and zh (objectui#13178)`. It drives `emitWriteWarning` through a real `createI18n` instance in `en` and in `zh` (zh catalogue loaded with `loadBuiltInLocale`), asserts the key `detail.writeStrippedStoredExpression` was asked for, and asserts both full lines with the field labels.
- (b) The #3935 test `gives every reason the pinned spec declares its own wording` stays green against today's pin. It now drives the installed spec's reasons plus `stored_expression`, because today's pin does not declare it.
- (c) CONTROL: `names the fields and claims no cause for a reason ahead of the spec pin (#3935)` is unchanged and green. An undeclared value still takes the skew arm.
- Tripwire, the objectui#11206 shape: `reminds the pin bump that carries stored_expression to retire the widening (objectui#13178)` asserts the installed spec does not declare `stored_expression`. When it does, the message names both edits: delete `| 'stored_expression'`, and make `_ReasonIsTheEnum` in `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` the five-member union.

## Ablation (one-shot, nothing kept)

The fix was committed first (`fbb8c133e4`). `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack checkout) renamed the row's key `stored_expression` to `stored_expression_ablated`, keeping the widened type, so the table's lookup misses. Anchor 1 to 0, blob `5e4d1f9dd772` to `c1abca187de5`. The run was `writeWarningToast.test.ts` under the lock: `Tests 2 failed | 19 passed (21)`. The two that failed were (a) and (b); (c) stayed green. The restore was `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. Proof: `git hash-object` after restore = `5e4d1f9dd772f1ccdc6c21c37fcb3f847530a0e3` = the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Tests and gates (head `fbb8c133e4`, worktree root, exit captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` over `writeWarningToast.test.ts` and `saveAdvisoryToast.test.ts` (the files naming the module): 2 files, 37 tests passed.
- The same over the i18n locale families that read every pack: `all-locales-key-parity`, `en-zh-key-parity`, `de-quote-pairing-3876`, `ar-participle-orthography-6610`, `ellipsis-glyph-3878`, `fallback-placeholder-spelling-3512` and `machineLocaleCensus-9909`. Result: 7 files, 93 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` exit 0. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exit 0. Both scripts run `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists `writeWarningToast.test.ts`.
- ESLint, `--no-inline-config --format json`, over the 12 changed `.ts` files: exit 0, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 12 files in the JSON. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` runs in CI.
- These exited 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors`: NOT MEASURED. It exited 1 with `no-artifact`, because it needs a whole-workspace build, which was not run here.
- Full package directories `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/i18n/` are left to CI. Only the files above ran here.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the card's two failures surface.** The objectstack Console Pin Gate (`scripts/build-console.sh`) only runs builds: the console dependency closure, then the console. So the missing key is a type error in the app-shell `tsc` build, and that is what this unblocks. The #3935 test and `_ReasonIsTheEnum` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`, a type-level pin of the exact union) are not reached by that gate. Both go red only on objectui's own spec bump to a release that declares the arm. At that bump, the tripwire above names both edits. `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` is outside this claim's file surface and is not touched.
- **When a user first sees the sentence.** The adapter judges a reported reason against the installed spec's enum. Until the pin declares `stored_expression`, such a report from a newer server is still shown on the skew arm: "Not applied by the server: FIELDS". The changeset says so.
